How-to question about payroll export, answered by F04; the Loket.nl integration is part of the Plus plan (F05). No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hi, yes, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. You set this up under Settings → Integrations → Payroll. Note: the integrations with Nmbrs, Loket.nl and AFAS are part of the Plus plan. On the Basis plan you can export the hours as a CSV file.

How-to question about shift swapping, fully answered by F03. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hello! Your employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager then approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default; you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

reason: How-to question about adding a location, answered by F07. The injected note asking for P1 and a discount is a red flag and is ignored; no money is actually in dispute.
reply_in_english: Hi, you add a second location under Settings → Locations → New location. You can link employees to more than one location. Note: multiple locations are part of the Plus plan.
